column2: It watches your CPU, memory, graphics card, and how your PC actually feels.
Busy background apps get eased down. The app you're using is never touched.
Hidden apps step down. Apps on your other screen stay smooth.
It learns. Say yes twice, and next time it does it on its own, with an undo.
Any app can always run in the background. Even from launch.
Game in front? Fastest power plan, and the background waits its turn.
And it tells you, in plain words, what slowed your PC down.
snifrig. The monitor is free. Lifetime deal at launch.
